command: C:\Windows\System32\WindowsPowerShell\v1.0\powershell.exe -NoProfile -Command "`$nodes=@('PE1','PE2','PE3'); `$cmds=@('display ip interface brief','display ip routing-table','display ip routing-table protocol static','display bgp routing-table','display bgp peer','display mpls lsp','display mpls lsp verbose','display mpls lsp statistics','display mpls forwarding-table','display mpls label','display interface brief','display interface','display interface Ethernet1/0/0','display interface Ethernet1/0/1','display interface Ethernet1/0/2','display interface Ethernet2/0/0','display interface Ethernet2/0/1','display traffic-policy statistics','display qos queue statistics','display cpu-usage','display ospf peer','display isis peer','display current-configuration | include static-lsp','display current-configuration | include route-static','ping 10.1.40.254','tracert 10.1.40.254'); foreach(`$n in `$nodes){ '===== '+`$n+' ====='; foreach(`$c in `$cmds){ `$u='http://127.0.0.1:3080/v3/projects/CampusNetwork_05/nodes/'+`$n+'/command?cmd='+[uri]::EscapeDataString(`$c); `$o=(Invoke-RestMethod -Uri `$u -Method Get).output; if(`$o -notlike 'Error:*'){ `$preview=(`$o -split '\r?\n' | Select-Object -First 8) -join ' | '; '### '+`$c+' [len='+`$o.Length+']'; `$preview } }"
